description: Structured Pydantic schema for StartupCategoryClassifier agent output.

primary_category.description: Primary startup category classification (e.g. AI, HealthTech, SaaS, FinTech).
primary_category.title: Primary Category

industry.description: Primary industry vertical (e.g. Healthcare, Agriculture, Financial Services).
industry.title: Industry

technology_domains.description: Core technology domains involved (e.g. Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Cloud API).
technology_domains.title: Technology Domains

business_model.description: Business model structure (e.g., B2B, B2C, D2C, B2G, Marketplace, Subscription, Platform, Enterprise).
business_model.title: Business Model

revenue_model.description: Primary revenue model (e.g., Subscription, Freemium, Transaction Fee, Licensing, Usage Based).
revenue_model.title: Revenue Model

startup_stage.description: Current estimated startup stage (e.g., Idea, MVP, Prototype, Early Revenue, Growth, Scale).
startup_stage.title: Startup Stage

confidence_score.description: Classification confidence score rating from 0 to 100.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

reasoning.description: Concise rationale explaining the classification decision.
reasoning.title: Reasoning

title: StartupCategoryClassification
